title: Build Exceeded Time Limit / Build Timeout
text:
Symptom: CI/CD pipeline or build platform reports 'Error: Build exceeded the time limit of 45 minutes', 'Build timed out', or 'Job exceeded maximum execution time'. The build process is killed before completing.

Root Cause: Build step contains an infinite loop or hung process, test suite running integration tests that require external services (not mocked), Webpack/Next.js bundle optimization taking excessive time due to large dependencies, or build machine is underpowered for the workload.

Diagnosis Steps:
1. Check build logs for the last step before timeout — it shows where the hang occurred
2. Run build locally with timing: 'time npm run build'
3. Check for accidental network calls in build scripts that await responses from down services
4. Profile webpack: add 'speed-measure-webpack-plugin' to identify slow loaders

Fix:
- Optimize bundle: enable tree-shaking, lazy loading, and code splitting in next.config.js
- Increase timeout for legitimate long builds: update CI config (GitHub Actions: timeout-minutes: 60)
- Fix infinite loops: search for 'while(true)' or recursive calls without base cases in build scripts
- Mock external services in test phase: set TEST_MODE=true to skip integration calls
- Split build into parallel jobs: build frontend and backend concurrently
- For Acme Vercel builds: check Vercel > Project > Settings > Build & Development > Build Command timeout
- Use caching: cache node_modules between CI runs (actions/cache@v3)

Prevention: Set explicit timeouts on all async operations; profile builds monthly; set alerts if build time exceeds 20 minutes.
